% A revtex4-2 letter in two columns: the reprint option sets the page
% with ltxgrid, and prl numbers no section.
\documentclass[aps,prl,twocolumn,reprint]{revtex4-2}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
\title{Revhead letter}
\author{Someone}
\begin{abstract}
Text of the letter's abstract.
\end{abstract}
\maketitle
\section{First section}
Text of the first section.
\subsection{A subsection}
Text of the subsection.
\section{Second section}
Text of the second section.
\begin{acknowledgments}
Text of the acknowledgments.
\end{acknowledgments}
\end{document}
